name: Twelve Data
label: Twelve Data
description: Twelve Data official API via OfficialApiNode (api_spec.json). Operations: quote, time_series, eod, fx_rate, crypto_quote. Docs: https://twelvedata.com/docs. Twelve Data REST terms. apikey query. Credit meter. Delayed/realtime per plan. Secrets stay in configurationParameters. jobType custom-script-executor.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: One Twelve Data request. Set operation plus the fields that operation requires. Delivered as inputVariables.input. Do not put secrets on this port. Example: {"operation":"quote"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Which official HTTP operation to run. EXACT values: quote | time_series | eod | fx_rate | crypto_quote. Default: first listed or instance operation. Example: 'quote'.

schema.label: date
schema.description: Sent as path, query, or JSON body field `date` for the selected operation. Omit when unused. Do not put secrets here.

schema.label: end_date
schema.description: Sent as path, query, or JSON body field `end_date` for the selected operation. Omit when unused. Do not put secrets here.

schema.label: interval
schema.description: Bar size. Required on time_series. Accepted: 1min | 5min | 15min | 30min | 45min | 1h | 2h | 4h | 1day | 1week | 1month.

schema.label: outputsize
schema.description: Sent as path, query, or JSON body field `outputsize` for the selected operation. Omit when unused. Do not put secrets here.

schema.label: start_date
schema.description: Sent as path, query, or JSON body field `start_date` for the selected operation. Omit when unused. Do not put secrets here.

schema.label: symbol
schema.description: Ticker. Required. Stocks: AAPL. FX: USD/EUR. Crypto: BTC/USD. All ops.

schema.label: timezone
schema.description: Exchange timezone or UTC. time_series / quote. Example: Exchange or UTC. https://twelvedata.com/docs#time-series

schema.label: format
schema.description: time_series response format. EXACT: JSON | CSV. Default JSON.

schema.label: dp
schema.description: Decimal places for quote / time_series. Example: 2.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success: {status:'ok', http_status, data}. Secrets never echoed. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body (or raw text if not JSON). Never includes the API secret.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default operation when input.operation is omitted. EXACT: quote, time_series, eod, fx_rate, crypto_quote.

configurationParameters.label: Apikey
configurationParameters.description: Provider secret. OfficialApiNode auth type `query`. Bind a StudioQuack secret. Never log, never put on INPUT.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout Seconds
configurationParameters.description: Connect+read timeout seconds. Default 25. Keep under the daemon sandbox request budget.
